glosses.notes: In this dataset the display form is written as 料2. It means to expect or guess that something will happen.

examples.sentence: 谁也没有料2到事情会这样变，所以大家先把后面的安排停下来，再一点一点看哪里出了问题。
我原来就料2到他不会马上同意，所以见面以前先把要说的话写得很清楚，免得说到一半又乱了。
母亲一听我说想换工作，就料2到我已经想了很久，她没有马上反对，只叫我先把生活安排好。

example_translations.translation: No one had guessed that things would change like this, so everyone first stopped the later arrangements and then looked bit by bit at where the problem had appeared.
I had already anticipated that he would not agree right away, so before meeting him I wrote down clearly what I wanted to say, so that things would not become confused halfway through.

As soon as my mother heard me say that I wanted to change jobs, she guessed that I had been thinking about it for a long time. She did not object immediately, but only told me to arrange my life well first.

glosses.notes: Refers to being drenched or poured over, often by rain, water, or another liquid.

examples.sentence: 我们刚出门就下雨了，大家虽然都走得很快，还是有几个人被雨淋了，后来只好先回去换衣服。
他把花放在窗外的时候没有多想，夜里一场雨下来，第二天一看，全都被雨淋坏了。
做完运动以后别马上站在风里，不然汗还没有干，又被雨一淋，人就很容易生病。

example_translations.translation: We had barely gone out when it started to rain. Although everyone walked quickly, several people were still drenched by the rain, and later they had no choice but to go back first and change clothes.
He did not think much when he put the flowers outside the window. After a night of rain, he looked the next day and found that all of them had been damaged by getting drenched.
Do not stand in the wind right after exercising. Otherwise, before your sweat has dried, if the rain drenches you again, you can easily get sick.

glosses.notes: Refers to the very early hours after midnight, when most people are still asleep.

examples.sentence: 她到家已经是凌晨了，可是看到客厅的灯还亮着，就知道家里人一直没有放心去睡。
医院那边在凌晨打来电话的时候，我们都先不说话了，因为谁也没想到事情会来得这么快。
火车原来说晚上到，后来因为天气一直不好，我们等到凌晨才看到它慢慢开过来。

example_translations.translation: By the time she got home it was already the very early morning, but when she saw that the living-room light was still on, she knew the family had not felt at ease enough to go to sleep.
When the hospital called in the early morning, we all fell silent first, because no one had expected things to come so quickly.
The train had originally been supposed to arrive at night, but because the weather kept being bad, we waited until the early morning before we finally saw it slowly come in.

glosses.notes: A process or set order of steps for getting something done.

examples.sentence: 这套流程看起来不复杂，但真做起来的时候，每一步都要有人确认，不然后面的问题会越来越大。
新同事刚来的时候最怕记不住流程，所以她每天都把要做的事按顺序写下来，下班前再自己看一遍。
领导改流程不是为了让大家更累，而是想把那些来回重复的部分先去掉，让时间放到更重要的地方。

example_translations.translation: This process does not look complicated, but when you really carry it out, every step needs someone to confirm it. Otherwise the problems later on will grow bigger and bigger.

When the new coworker had just arrived, what she feared most was not remembering the process, so every day she wrote down in order the things she had to do and then read through them herself again before leaving work.
The manager changed the process not to make everyone more tired, but to remove those back-and-forth repeated parts first, so that time could be put into more important places.

glosses.notes: Describes people, water, air, money, or information moving and flowing from one place to another.

examples.sentence: 水在石头中间慢慢流动，看上去很安静，可是走近一点才知道下面的声音一直没有停。
假期一到，车站里的人就开始流动，很多工作人员从早到晚都没有真正坐下来休息过。
空气在这个小房间里不容易流动，所以大家开会开久了以后，都会觉得头有一点重。

example_translations.translation: The water flows slowly between the stones. It looks very quiet, but only when you go a little closer do you realize that the sound below has never stopped.
As soon as the holiday arrives, people in the station begin to flow through, and many staff members do not truly get to sit down and rest from morning until night.
Air does not flow easily in this small room, so after everyone has been in the meeting for a long time, they all feel that their heads are a little heavy.

glosses.notes: A browser used for opening and viewing websites on a computer or phone.

examples.sentence: 老师让我们换一个浏览器再试，因为有些内容不是没有发出来，而是旧浏览器一直不支持。
她的浏览器开了太多东西，所以电脑明明没有很老，还是慢得让人等一会儿就想关掉。
如果浏览器一直记着旧数据，你改完以后看上去像是什么都没变，其实不是程序没有动。

example_translations.translation: The teacher told us to try another browser, because some content had not failed to be sent out; the old browser simply did not support it.
She had too many things open in her browser, so even though the computer was not really that old, it was still so slow that after waiting a little while you wanted to close it.
If the browser keeps remembering old data, then after you finish changing things, it can look as if nothing has changed, when in fact the program is not the part that failed to move.

glosses.notes: Can refer to internet data usage, online traffic, or the amount of people moving through a place.

examples.sentence: 这个月手机流量用得比平时快很多，我一查才发现，是那个软件一直在后面自己放东西。
老板不只看网上流量高不高，他更在意进来的人最后是不是真的买了东西。
门口的人流量一大，里面做事的人就知道今天又不能按平时的速度慢慢来了。

example_translations.translation: This month my phone data was used up much faster than usual. Only after I checked did I realize that one app had been running things by itself in the background.
The boss does not only look at whether online traffic is high or not. He cares more about whether the people who come in actually end up buying something.
As soon as the flow of people at the entrance grows large, the people working inside know that today once again they cannot keep doing things slowly at the usual pace.

glosses.notes: Means to flow into a place, often for water, people, money, or other things entering an area.

examples.sentence: 一到下班的时候，车和人都一起往这条路上流入，所以这条路总会堵很久。
雨下了半天，水不断从高处流入院子，大家只好先把门口能动的东西都搬进去。
新的客人一下流入店里以后，老板先没有高兴太早，因为后面还有很多事要马上跟上。

example_translations.translation: As soon as it is time to get off work, both cars and people flow onto this road together, so the road always stays blocked for a long time.
It rained for half the day, and water kept flowing into the yard from higher ground, so everyone had no choice but to first move inside everything at the door that could be moved.
After new customers suddenly flowed into the shop, the owner did not get happy too early, because there were still many things afterward that had to keep up at once.

glosses.notes: Refers to circulating or moving through a system, market, or society so that things can be exchanged or passed along.

examples.sentence: 钱只有真正流通起来，开店的人和工作的人才都能慢慢有事做，这一点大家后来都明白了。
这种药在小地方不容易流通，所以病人有时候明明拿着单子，也要跑很远才能买到。
消息如果不能公开流通，大家就只能听一点传一点，最后什么话都有可能变样。

example_translations.translation: Only when money truly circulates can the people who run shops and the people who work gradually have things to do. Later everyone came to understand this point.
This kind of medicine does not circulate easily in small places, so sometimes patients clearly have the paper in hand and still have to travel far before they can buy it.
If information cannot circulate openly, then everyone can only hear a little and pass on a little, and in the end any message can change shape.

glosses.notes: The hallway or corridor inside a building, especially in an apartment block.

examples.sentence: 孩子在楼道里跑来跑去的时候，下面那家人总会先出来看一眼，因为声音在晚上特别明显。
楼道的灯又坏了，父亲一边上楼一边说，明天一定要去找人修，不然老人晚上回来太不方便。
我们在楼道里站了很久才把话说完，因为里面人多，真正想讲的事反而不容易开口。

example_translations.translation: When children run back and forth in the corridor, the family downstairs always comes out to look first, because the noise is especially obvious at night.

The hallway light was broken again. While going upstairs, my father said that tomorrow he definitely had to find someone to fix it, otherwise it would be too inconvenient for old people coming back at night.
We stood in the corridor for a long time before finishing what we had to say, because there were many people inside, and what we truly wanted to talk about was instead not easy to bring up.

glosses.notes: This form is pronounced lòu here and means to reveal or let something show.

examples.sentence: 他说前面那些话的时候还很平静，可是一提到家里的事，脸上还是露了怕，大家一看就知道了。
孩子嘴上说自己不怕，可是手一摸到水，脸上马上就露了紧张，老师只好先带着他慢慢来。
他一直想把事情说得轻一点，但是说到最后，语气里还是露了不满，所以大家都知道他心里有意见。

example_translations.translation: He was still very calm when saying those earlier words, but as soon as he mentioned the family matter, his face still revealed fear, and everyone understood it with one look.
The child said he was not afraid, but the moment his hand touched the water, his face immediately showed tension, so the teacher had no choice but to guide him slowly first.
He kept wanting to speak of the matter more lightly, but by the end his tone still revealed dissatisfaction, so everyone knew that he had opinions in his heart.

glosses.notes: A loophole, leak, or weak point in a plan, system, or argument that can cause problems later.

examples.sentence: 计划写得再漂亮，只要流程里还有漏洞，真正开始做的时候，问题还是会一个一个出来。
他把文件看了两遍，就是怕自己漏掉那个最小的漏洞，到时候出了事谁都说不清。
系统刚开始用的那天就有人发现漏洞，所以公司马上停下别的安排，先把最危险的地方补好。

example_translations.translation: No matter how beautifully the plan is written, as long as there is still a loophole in the process, once the real work begins, problems will still come out one after another.
He read the document twice because he was afraid of missing even the smallest loophole. If something happened later, then no one would be able to explain it clearly.
On the very day the system began to be used, someone discovered a漏洞, so the company immediately stopped its other arrangements and first fixed the most dangerous place well.

glosses.notes: In this dataset the display form is written as 露1. It refers to revealing, showing, or letting something appear.

examples.sentence: 这件事先不要露1太多，等前面的准备都做好以后，再把真正的计划告诉外面的人。
他本来不想露1，可是大家都到了，他再不出来说两句，别人只会更怕。
孩子一听见要上台，脸上先露1出一点怕，可是走到中间以后，声音反而越来越平静。

example_translations.translation: Do not reveal too much about this matter yet. After the earlier preparations are all finished, then tell the people outside the real plan.
He had originally not wanted to show himself, but everyone had already arrived. If he still did not come out and say a couple of things, other people would only grow more afraid.
As soon as the child heard that he had to go on stage, his face first revealed a little fear, but after he walked to the middle, his voice instead became calmer and calmer.

glosses.notes: The travel distance or length of a route from one place to another.

examples.sentence: 从这里到医院的路程不算远，可是早上车一多，原来二十分钟能到的地方常常要走快一个小时。
孩子一路都在问还有多少路程，母亲没有直接回答，只是叫他先看窗外，到了会马上告诉他。
这段路程最难的不是远，而是中间一直没有地方休息，所以大家出发以前都要先把水带够。

example_translations.translation: The distance from here to the hospital is not very far, but once there are many cars in the morning, a place that originally took twenty minutes to reach often ends up taking nearly an hour.
The child kept asking all the way how much distance was left. His mother did not answer directly, but simply told him to look outside first and said she would tell him as soon as they arrived.
The hardest part of this stretch of distance is not that it is far, but that there is no place to rest the whole way, so everyone has to make sure to bring enough water before setting out.

glosses.notes: Refers to road conditions such as traffic, weather effects, and whether the road is easy or hard to use.

examples.sentence: 司机一看今天的路况，就知道原来那条线不能走了，不然大家还没到中午就会全堵在路上。
下雨以后路况一直在变，所以他开车的时候说得很少，注意力都放在前面那点地方上。
我们出发以前先看了路况，不是怕多开一点，而是怕天黑以后有些路会更不好走。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the driver looked at today’s road conditions, he knew the original route could no longer be used, otherwise everyone would be completely stuck on the road before noon.
After the rain, the road conditions kept changing, so while driving he spoke very little, and all of his attention stayed on the little stretch in front.
Before setting out, we first checked the road conditions, not because we were afraid of driving a little more, but because we feared that after dark some roads would become even harder to travel.

glosses.notes: The road surface itself, especially when talking about whether it is damaged, wet, icy, or newly repaired.

examples.sentence: 昨天下过雨以后，这里的路面一直没有干，所以车一过来，路上的人都得先往后让一步。
工人把坏掉的路面重新修好以后，车开过去的时候安静了很多，住在这条街的人都松了一口气。
冬天最怕早上看不出问题，可是路面已经很不好走，所以老师总提醒大家出门不要走得太快。

example_translations.translation: After the rain yesterday, the road surface here still had not dried, so whenever a car came by, the people on the road all had to step back first.
After the workers repaired the damaged road surface, cars became much quieter when passing by, and the people living on this street all let out a sigh of relief.

What people fear most in winter is when no problem can be seen in the morning, yet the road surface is already very hard to walk on, so teachers always remind everyone not to walk too fast when going out.

glosses.notes: Can mean a video recording itself or the act of recording something on video.

examples.sentence: 门口的录像已经看过很多遍了，虽然没有马上找到人，但是至少让大家知道问题大概是几点发生的。
他把比赛的录像留到晚上才看，因为白天事情太多，只有那个时候才有心情慢慢想哪里没做好。
如果只看一遍录像就下结论，很容易把一时的失误当成长期的问题，所以教练让大家多看几次。

example_translations.translation: The video recording from the entrance has already been watched many times. Although the person was not found right away, it at least let everyone know roughly what time the problem happened.

He left the game recording for the evening before watching it, because there were too many things during the day, and only at that time did he have the mood to slowly think about where he had not done well.
If you look at a recording only once and then draw a conclusion, it is easy to treat a temporary mistake as a long-term problem, so the coach told everyone to watch it several more times.

glosses.notes: To hire, recruit, or formally accept someone for a job or position.

examples.sentence: 公司最后录用她，不只是因为成绩好，更因为她回答问题的时候很清楚，知道自己能做什么。
他原来以为自己不会被录用，没想到电话真的打来的时候，反而先不说话了，不知道该先告诉谁。
老师说，面试能不能被录用，当然要看准备，可是更重要的是你说出来的话是不是像你真的做过。

example_translations.translation: In the end the company hired her not only because her grades were good, but even more because when answering questions she was very clear and knew what she was able to do.
He had originally thought he would not be hired, but when the phone call really came, he fell silent instead and did not know whom he should tell first.
The teacher said that whether you can be hired in an interview of course depends on preparation, but what matters even more is whether what you say sounds like something you have really done.

glosses.notes: To record or produce audio or video material in an organized way.

examples.sentence: 节目开始录制以前，主持人先把流程又看了一遍，因为现场一忙起来，谁都有可能忘掉最小的一步。
他们为了录制这段内容，前后改了很多次，不是不知道怎么说，而是想让外面的人第一次听也能明白。
录制那天刚好天气不好，可是大家还是按原来的时间开始，因为再往后拖，后面的安排全会乱。

example_translations.translation: Before the program started recording, the host first looked through the process again, because once the scene gets busy, anyone may forget even the smallest step.

In order to record this piece of content, they revised it many times from beginning to end, not because they did not know how to say it, but because they wanted people outside to understand it even on the first listen.
The weather happened to be bad on the day of recording, but everyone still started at the original time, because if it were delayed any further, all the later arrangements would fall into confusion.

glosses.notes: A journey, especially when talking about the overall experience of traveling from one place to another.

examples.sentence: 这段旅程让他最难忘的，不是看到了多少新地方，而是一路上认识的那些人后来还一直有来往。
我们本来把旅程想得很轻松，真的上路以后才发现，只要有人身体不舒服，整个计划都要跟着改。
旅程快结束的时候，她反而没有一开始那么兴奋了，因为真正放在心里的东西，要回去以后才慢慢明白。

example_translations.translation: What made this journey most unforgettable for him was not how many new places he saw, but that the people he met along the way later continued to keep in touch.
We had originally imagined the journey as very easy, but only after really setting out did we discover that as long as someone did not feel well, the entire plan had to change along with it.
When the journey was about to end, she was instead not as excited as she had been at the beginning, because the things truly placed in the heart only become clear little by little after returning.

glosses.notes: A trip or travel route, often focusing on what happens during the time on the road.

examples.sentence: 孩子在旅途上最开始一直问什么时候到，后来坐久了，靠在母亲身上睡着以后，车里反而一下安静下来。
一个人走长一点的旅途，不怕路远，就怕手机没电以后，想联系家里的人却找不到机会。
那次旅途虽然不算顺利，但是大家后来回头看，都觉得最难的那几个小时反而让彼此更相信对方。

example_translations.translation: At the beginning of the trip, the child kept asking when they would arrive. Later, after sitting for a long time and falling asleep against his mother, the inside of the car instead suddenly became quiet.
When one person goes on a somewhat longer journey, the fear is not that the road is far, but that after the phone runs out of power, they want to contact people at home and cannot find the chance.
Although that trip was not especially smooth, when everyone looked back later, they all felt that those most difficult few hours had instead made them trust one another more.

glosses.notes: To carry out, fulfill, or perform a duty, promise, or responsibility.

examples.sentence: 答应别人的事就要履行，这不是给别人看，而是你如果连自己说过的话都不当回事，后面谁还会放心。
公司前面答应的内容，最后能不能真正履行，大家看得不是口号，而是后面它是不是这样做。
父亲常说，人和人之间最难的不是说清楚，而是说完以后肯不肯按自己答应的那样去履行。

example_translations.translation: If you promise something to others, you should fulfill it. This is not for others to watch; rather, if you do not even take your own words seriously, then later who will still feel at ease?
Whether the things the company promised earlier can truly be carried out in the end is judged by people not through slogans, but through whether it actually does things that way afterward.
My father often says that the hardest thing between people is not explaining things clearly, but whether after speaking, one is willing to carry them out as one had promised.

glosses.notes: Used as the rate or proportion part in words about percentages, success, use, or qualification.

examples.sentence: 这次考试的合格率没有大家想得那么高，所以老师决定把学生最容易错的地方再讲一遍。
大家都想把成功率提上去，可是真正能不能做好，还是得看前面的准备是不是认真。
这个办法看上去能省时间，可是如果利用率一直不高，最后还是会让人觉得花了力气却没有多少结果。

example_translations.translation: The pass rate on this exam was not as high as everyone had expected, so the teacher decided to explain once more the places where students were most likely to make mistakes.
Everyone wants to raise the success rate, but whether the job can really be done well still depends on whether the earlier preparation was serious.
This method looks as if it can save time, but if the utilization rate stays low all along, people will still feel in the end that they spent effort without getting many results.

glosses.notes: To add greenery or do greening work, especially in streets, neighborhoods, or public spaces.

examples.sentence: 这条路两边原来什么都没有，后来慢慢做了绿化，夏天太阳最大的时候，走路的人也没有以前那么难受。
小区今年把绿化重新安排了一次，不只是为了好看，也是想让孩子下楼以后能有更舒服的地方活动。
城市做绿化不能只看开始那几天多漂亮，还要看后面有没有人一直管，不然过不了多久又会乱。

example_translations.translation: Originally there was nothing on either side of this road, but later greening work was gradually done, and when the sun is strongest in summer, people walking there no longer suffer as much as before.

This year the residential area rearranged its greening once again, not only for appearance, but also in the hope that after going downstairs children would have a more comfortable place to move around.

When a city does greening work, it cannot look only at how beautiful the first few days are. It also has to see whether people will keep managing it later, otherwise before long everything becomes messy again.

glosses.notes: Can mean a wheel, taking turns, or a round of activity depending on context.

examples.sentence: 这已经是我们今天开的第三轮会了，大家都很累，可是那个最重要的问题还是没有真正说清楚。
孩子一开始总想自己先来，后来老师叫大家轮着来，他才慢慢明白，等一会儿并不代表没有机会。
母亲说今天轮到我做饭，我本来还想找理由出去，可是一看大家都在忙，只好先把手里的事放下。

example_translations.translation: This is already the third round of meetings we have had today. Everyone is tired, yet that most important problem still has not truly been explained clearly.

At first the child always wanted to go first by himself. Later the teacher told everyone to take turns, and only then did he slowly understand that waiting for a little while does not mean there is no chance.

My mother said that today it was my turn to cook. I had originally still wanted to find an excuse to go out, but once I saw that everyone was busy, I had no choice but to put down what was in my hands first.
